- Warm cool white LED icicle lights
- Durable black and white rubber cable
- Connectable upto 50m length

Add a magical glow to your home or garden with our premium LED Icicle Lights, crafted from durable rubber cable and available in Warm White or Cool White, with or without a gentle 10 percent twinkle. Perfect for creating a cosy winter ambience or a sparkling summer feature, they are ideal for gutters, eaves, patios, decking, pergolas and indoor areas. The connectable design allows you to easily build the right length for your space, with 2m or 5m sections that link together up to 50m. As part of our mains voltage connectable range, these lights can be easily expanded for larger displays. Combining professional quality with simple installation, our LED Icicle Lights bring warmth, elegance and brilliance to any occasion, transforming everyday spaces or festive scenes with ease and charm.

Give guests a bright festive welcome with the Christow Merry Christmas Rope Light Sign with Santa & Gingerbread Man. Measuring 173.5cm wide, it features white lettering flanked by colourful Santa Claus and gingerbread man characters. Milk-coloured rope light tubing creates a neon-style glow, while seven flash speeds bring the “Merry Christmas” message to life, making it a fun feature for walls and fences. Seven Flash Speeds & Static Mode Bring the white “Merry Christmas” wording to life using the adjustable speed controller. Choose from seven speeds to make the message flash faster or slower, or select the static option for continuous illumination. Elevate your Christmas decor with the brilliance of these super bright icicle lights. These lights are perfect for adorning your space with a stunning wintry glow. Often used for hanging from roof edges or guttering, they add a touch of enchantment to your festive setting. Operated by mains power, this light set is a breeze to install thanks to the generous lead from the plug to the first LED. The built-in timer function, allowing 8 hours on and 16 hours off, efficiently manages energy usage. These non-replaceable, energy-efficient LEDs offer extended lifespan and substantial cost savings compared to halogen bulbs.
